workload: 64,509 post-Twig Altimood Markdown blocks; Comrak via persistent NativeWorker with declined blocks rendered by the downstream PHP parser
method: Three separate uncached PHP workers on one CPU. PHP baseline times transform() only. Hybrid times reused-worker requests and PHP transform() for declined blocks. Every produced block is compared byte-for-byte with the private snapshot and the aggregate digest matches the current PHP baseline.
limits: The downstream site has its own installed Pushword version; this does not prove parity with the current monorepo PHP parser.
Post-Twig block parity does not prove complete page, admin preview, static build or HTTP parity.
Kernel startup, Twig expansion, snapshot decoding, SQL, cache hits and complete page assembly are outside these timings.
Eligibility is conservative and snapshot-specific; unseen syntax or parser differences may still require PHP fallback.
